question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Courage
solution:
The correct answer is **"Valour."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Courage"** means the ability to do something that frightens one. (अप्रिय ख़तरनाक स्थिति में भय को नियंत्रित करने की क्षमता; साहस, हिम्‍मत, बहादुरी)

 
 
• **Example:** *It took real **courage**__ to go back into the burning building.*
 
 
 
• **"Valour"** means great bravery in the face of danger. (महान साहस और निर्भीकता)
 __
 
• **Example:** *The soldier showed great **valour**__ in the battlefield.*
 
 
 
• **"Valour"** is a synonym for **"courage."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Timidity** means lack of courage or confidence.
 
• **Cowardice** means a lack of bravery.
 
• **Ingenuity** means the quality of being clever, original, and inventive.

88:T45d,
The correct answer is "**London.**"
